card.name: First digit of infusion rates and concentrations
card.fires_on: The first digit of a number (often 6, 3, 5 or 1) that starts a rate, strength or concentration, as in 60 to 70 mL/kg/day or 6 mg iodine/mL. Also an opening parenthesis before a unit such as (g/kg/hour).

modes.label: Leading digit of a dose figure
modes.description: A single digit that begins a number for a rate, strength or concentration in nutrition or infusion text.
modes.example: at a rate of about <<6>>0 to 70 mL/kg/day

modes.label: Parenthesis before a unit
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a nutrient name in a dosing table, just before the unit.

card.writes: It seems to steer the next token toward continuing the number, and away from words like 'each', 'a small amount' or 'appropriate amount'.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a number in a feeding or infusion rate or concentration, where the rest of the number is still to come.
